Added screen timout restriction to enjoy usage

items.title: Bugstars Equipment
items.description: Choose the Smart Approach when you hit the Jewel Heist. For gold you need to grab the Bugstars van without getting spotted by anyone.

items.title: Minisub
items.description: The Merryweather Heist lets you pick either Offshore or Freighter, both work fine. Gold requires finishing in 8:30 and snatching the Submersible without ever setting foot on the boat.

items.title: Tow Truck
items.description: Gold means wrapping this up in 3:00, bringing back the Tow Truck without a scratch, and maxing out the truck's speed.

items.title: By the Book
items.description: For gold you need to keep Mr K's heart beating the entire time, shock him with electricity, pull out his tooth, hit him with the wrench, and waterboard him.

items.title: Eye in the Sky
items.description: Gold requires returning the Z-Type without any damage, listening in on 3 different conversations, and finding Chad's hiding spot on your first try.

items.title: Blitz Play
items.description: Take down the helicopter while playing as Trevor, get 12 headshot kills, maintain 60% accuracy, and switch between characters 10 times for gold.

items.title: Friend Request
items.description: Finish in 8:30 and close all the popups within 32 seconds to get gold.

items.title: Driller
items.description: Pick the Obvious Approach when you do The Big Score. For gold steal the Cutter without getting caught and wrap everything up in 5:00.

items.title: Fire Truck
items.description: When you finish Architect's Plans choose the Covert Setup for The Bureau Raid. Gold needs you to call 911 for the fire department and bring back the Fire Truck without any damage.

items.title: Fresh Meat
items.description: Stick to 3 character switches maximum, land 70% of your shots, score 10 headshot kills, rescue Michael in 3:30, and skip using the map waypoint for gold. Michael is trapped in a Slaughterhouse down in the south-eastern corner of the city.

items.title: Hood Safari
items.description: Beat it in 7:00, keep your shooting accuracy at 70%, and get 12 headshot kills for gold.

items.title: The Long Stretch
items.description: Gold means maintaining 60% shooting accuracy, dropping 10 enemies with headshots, avoiding serious health or armor damage, and clearing it in 10:30.

items.title: Chop
items.description: For gold keep Lamar's van mostly intact, control Chop for at least 10 seconds, and use Franklin's special ability for 7 seconds.

items.title: Pack Man
items.description: Finish in 12:00, keep the JB 700 pristine, and wreck 3 cop cars using the spikes to get gold.

items.title: Hang Ten
items.description: Gold just needs you to finish in 4:00. After this mission Floyd's Apartment becomes unavailable as a safehouse and Trevor moves into the Vanilla Unicorn Strip Club instead.

items.title: The Merryweather Heist
items.description: The Freighter approach needs 12 headshot kills, 80% accuracy, 12 stealth takedowns, finding the container in 60 seconds, and reaching the ship interior undetected for gold. The Offshore approach requires recovering the container in 2:00, completing in 14:30, wiping out all Merryweather pursuers, and losing the Merryweather chase in under 4 minutes.

items.title: Scouting the Port
items.description: Wrap it up in 20:00, keep the container damage-free, capture all 3 boat photos exactly as specified, and avoid causing any trouble at the docks for gold.

items.title: The Big Score
items.description: The Subtle Approach needs 20 headshot kills, changing traffic lights fewer than 10 times, and 60% accuracy for gold. The Obvious Approach wants 20 headshots, finishing in 16:00, dumping the gold onto the train in 30 seconds, and hitting 60% of your shots.

items.title: Surveying the Score
items.description: For gold tail the vans without any distance warnings, find the construction hole in 20 seconds, fly under the bridge while tailing, zip through the tunnel during the chase, and finish everything in 11:00.

items.title: Masks
items.description: Gold requires buying every mask in 20 seconds and grabbing a white hockey mask for each character.

items.title: The Construction Assassination
items.description: For gold you need to shoot down the target's helicopter.

items.title: Gauntlet 2
items.description: This mission only shows up if you pick the Subtle Approach for The Big Score. Gold requires you to bring back the exact Gauntlet from the email, deliver it without any damage, and spend $17,000 on modifications.

items.title: Taxi Mission #4
items.description: Your fourth passenger is outside Ammu-Nation so stock up on weapons before you grab them.

items.title: Boiler Suits
items.description: Gold means buying all the outfits in under 30 seconds and making sure each character gets a different color.

items.title: Repossession
items.description: You need to finish within 06:30, light the gasoline trail, score 6 headshot kills, and keep your shooting accuracy at 70% or higher for gold.

items.title: Complications
items.description: Gold here means finishing in 05:00, taking no damage during the fight with Simeon, and using a stealth takedown on the gardener.

items.title: Architect's Plans
items.description: Get out of the construction site in 45 seconds or less for gold.

items.title: The Multi-Target Assassination
items.description: Take out all targets fast for gold, and before you finish this mission throw everything you have into Debonaire stock because the returns are insane.

items.title: The Hotel Assassination
items.description: Use a Sniper Rifle to drop the target for gold, and make sure you invest in Betta Pharmaceuticals before completing the mission since the profits are massive.

items.title: The Bureau Raid
items.description: If you go Fire Crew you need to finish in 18:00, escape with 40% oxygen remaining, clean the floor in under 03:00, and rappel down the elevator shaft within 30 seconds for gold. The Rooftop approach requires keeping all civilians alive, landing 20 headshots, maintaining 70% accuracy, nailing the landing on the main roof, hacking the system in 45 seconds, and completing everything within 19:00.

items.title: Cleaning out the Bureau
items.description: Scan every license plate, tail the janitor without getting spotted, and finish in 9:00 for gold.

items.title: Casing the Jewel Store
items.description: Capture all three security features in one photo for gold.

items.title: The Jewel Store Job
items.description: Gold means grabbing the jewelry in 50 seconds, keeping Franklin alive during the LS River chase, and smashing all 20 glass cabinets.

items.title: Stingersb
items.description: You only get this if you choose the Subtle Approach for The Big Score. Gold requires stealing the Police Transporter and escaping within 2:00, then delivering it without any damage.

items.title: The Vice Assassination
items.description: Get through without alerting the cops for gold, and invest heavily in Fruit stock before you finish because the payout is huge.

items.title: Three's Company
items.description: Finish in 7:30, keep your shooting accuracy at 60% or above, and drop 10 enemies with headshots for gold.

items.title: Gauntlet 1
items.description: This only appears if you go Subtle for The Big Score. Gold needs you to steal the exact Gauntlet shown in the email, bring it back without a scratch, and drop $17,000 on upgrades.

items.title: Carbine Rifles
items.description: This mission only unlocks if you pick the Loud Approach for the Jewel Heist. Shake your wanted level in 2:00 for gold.

items.title: Legal Trouble
items.description: Finish in 5:30, max out the speed on any car, lose your wanted level within 2:00, and watch the Weazel News camera for 15 seconds to get gold.

items.title: The Ballad of Rocco
items.description: Complete it in 3:00 for gold.

items.title: Mr. Richards
items.description: For gold you need to finish in under 10 minutes, take down three enemies using stealth attacks, avoid getting hit at all during the Rocco fight, and land the Frogger helicopter without any damage.

items.title: Trash Truck
items.description: Gold requires wrapping this up in under five minutes, delivering the Trashmaster with zero damage, and maxing out the Trashmaster's speed at some point during the mission.

items.title: I Fought the Law...
items.description: To get gold you need to thread the needle between those two trucks, shoot the gap between the buses, stay on Trevor through the tunnel, beat the clock at 12 minutes, and activate Franklin's ability during the race.

items.title: The Bus Assassination
items.description: Gold medal just needs you to take out the target with the bus.

items.title: Taxi Mission #1
items.description: Swing by the medical center entrance to grab your fare. This guy loves speed and chaos so go ahead and drive wild, just don't wreck.

items.title: Gauntlet 3
items.description: You need to pick the Subtle Approach for The Big Score first. For gold bring back the exact Gauntlet from the email, keep it pristine without a scratch, and drop $17,000 on mods for it.

items.title: Meltdown
items.description: Gold requires clearing it in 6 minutes 30 seconds, hitting max speed in any ride, scoring 12 headshot kills, and saving Amanda and Tracey with headshots.

items.title: Deep Inside
items.description: For gold return the JB 700 with minimal wear, push it to top speed, stealth takedown the actor, hit the ejector seat in under 10 seconds, and run the actor over while escaping.

items.title: Franklin and Lamar
items.description: Gold means bringing back the repo car looking clean, using Franklin's ability for seven seconds, beating Lamar in the race, and not hitting any aliens at the studio.

items.title: Taxi Mission #2
items.description: Passenger number two is hanging out near Up-n-Atom Burger. He's not feeling great so keep the driving smooth and steady.

items.title: Father/Son
items.description: Gold needs you to get to Jimmy in 10 seconds or less and bring Amanda's car back flawless.

items.title: Marriage Counseling
items.description: For gold keep the Bison damage-free, finish in 5 minutes 30 seconds, and drop three enemies from your vehicle.

items.title: Daddy's Little Girl
items.description: Gold requires maxing out the Seashark, staying on the bike the whole time, and swimming to the boat in under a minute.

items.title: Mr. Philips
items.description: To get gold wipe out every fleeing biker, land 12 headshot kills, finish in 12 minutes, rack up $5,000 damage to Ortega's trailer, and take out Terry and Clay during the chase.

items.title: Fame or Shame
items.description: Gold needs you to hit the Phantom's top speed, stick close to Lazlow the entire chase, knock out the event coordinator, and keep the trailer attached.

items.title: Did Somebody Say Yoga?
items.description: For gold wrap it up in 15 minutes, nail the first yoga pose perfectly, ace the second pose without messing up, and execute the third pose flawlessly.

items.title: Minor Turbulence
items.description: Gold requires ending with at least 80% shooting accuracy and bailing out of the cargo plane in the Mesa.

items.title: Bury the Hatchet
items.description: For gold finish within 11 minutes, score 20 headshot kills, and maintain at least 80% shooting accuracy.

items.title: Reuniting the Family
items.description: Gold just needs you to complete this within 10 minutes 30 seconds.

items.title: Taxi Mission #8
items.description: Pick up passenger eight at the Richman Hotel. Make sure you've got a 4-door ride for this trip.

items.title: Taxi Mission #7
items.description: Passenger seven is waiting at the Flagpole and needs a ride to meet his girlfriend on Elgin Avenue.

items.title: The Wrap Up
items.description: For gold you need to finish in under seven minutes, get eighteen headshot kills, and shoot down the helicopter that's tailing you.

items.title: The Third Way
items.description: You can unlock this by choosing Option C as Franklin after finishing The Big Score. Gold requires twenty headshot kills, keeping your accuracy at seventy percent or better, using a Sticky Bomb to kill Cheng, headshotting Steve Haines, and taking out Stretch with a melee attack. The replay feature lets you grab the medal even if you didn't originally pick option C.

items.title: The Time's Come
items.description: Pick Option B as Franklin after completing The Big Score to unlock this. The only gold requirement is killing a certain character. Replaying the mission works fine so you don't have to choose option B again just for the medal.

items.title: Something Sensible
items.description: Select Option A as Franklin once The Big Score wraps up. Gold means killing a specific character. Replay lets you earn the medal without needing to choose option A originally.

items.title: Lamar Down
items.description: Gold needs eighteen headshot kills, seventy percent accuracy or better, at least one kill per character, and finishing in thirteen minutes thirty seconds or less.

items.title: BZ Gas Grenades
items.description: Choose the Smart Approach when planning the Jewel Heist. The only gold requirement is shooting open the back doors and dumping the cargo out.

items.title: Caida Libre
items.description: For gold you need to max out the Sanchez speed, stay on the bike during the entire chase, shoot down the plane in exactly three shots, and complete everything in nine minutes forty-five seconds or less.

items.title: Taxi Mission #5
items.description: The fifth passenger is waiting in the Galileo Park parking lot and wants to go to the best tailor in the city, which you probably already know.

items.title: Dead Man Walking
items.description: Gold requires seventy percent accuracy or better, fourteen headshot kills, finishing within nine minutes thirty seconds, using Michael's special ability to kill four enemies, and keeping your health and armor damage low.

items.title: Military Hardware
items.description: This convoy drives around the map so the marker might not show the exact location. Gold means headshotting five enemies and using a sticky bomb to stop the convoy.

items.title: Predator
items.description: For gold finish with seventy percent accuracy or higher, beat it in under nine minutes, get three headshot kills, and make sure you don't hit any animals.

items.title: Cargobob
items.description: Pick the Offshore Approach for the Merryweather Heist. The only gold requirement is completing it in five minutes thirty seconds or less.

items.title: Sidetracked
items.description: Go with the Obvious Approach when setting up The Big Score. Gold needs you to finish within four minutes thirty seconds and steal the train without getting spotted by anyone.

items.title: Trevor Philips Industries
items.description: Gold requires killing thirty-two enemies, finishing without taking much health or armor damage, wrecking six vehicles, and completing it in four minutes thirty seconds or under.

items.title: Crystal Maze
items.description: For gold get ten headshot kills, don't take much damage to health or armor, kill two enemies with one shot, and finish with at least eighty percent accuracy.

items.title: Friends Reunitede
items.description: Gold means headshotting five enemies, blowing up the trailers without anyone spotting you, taking minimal damage to health and armor, and destroying every trailer in one explosion.

items.title: Nervous Ron
items.description: For gold headshot five enemies, beat it in twelve minutes thirty seconds or less, beat Ron in the race, fly under any six bridges along the route, and kill all the bikers while standing on the plane's wing.

items.title: Derailed
items.description: Gold needs you to finish in eleven minutes thirty seconds or less, hit the Sanchez top speed, and nail the jump onto the train on your first attempt.

items.title: Taxi Mission #3
items.description: Passenger three is waiting by the 24/7 Supermarket and needs to get to Vinewood fast, so skip the regular routes to score a Speed Bonus.

items.title: The Paleto Score
items.description: To snag the gold medal you need to burn through over 4000 bullets, maintain at least 50% accuracy on your shots, finish the whole thing in under 16 minutes, and cause a million dollars worth of destruction throughout Paleto Bay.

items.title: Paleto Score Setup
items.description: Gold medal means reaching the bank in 3 minutes 30 seconds or faster and then beating everyone else back to the meth lab.

items.title: Monkey Business
items.description: For the gold medal you have to stun 8 enemies with the Stun Gun, score 15 headshot kills, keep your accuracy at 70% or higher, and wrap everything up in 13 minutes 30 seconds or less.

items.title: Car Theft 2
items.description: This one only triggers as Michael and you chase down someone who stole a car then choose whether to return it to the owner or just keep it for yourself. Clearing any 14 random events counts toward getting 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 9
items.description: Any character can trigger this and you need to finish 14 random events total to count toward 100% completion.

items.title: Bike Thief City 1
items.description: Any character works here and you take out the bike thief then either return it to boost your driving skill or keep it, but returning it pays way better since a few days later you get $100,000 in Animal Ark stocks. You need 14 random events total for 100% progress.

items.title: Gang Intimidation
items.description: All three characters can trigger this and a woman flags you down claiming she was attacked but it's a trap that leads you around the corner where 4 gang members ambush you. Completing 14 random events pushes you toward 100% completion.

items.title: Getaway Driver
items.description: Works with any character and once the thieves jump in your car you get hit with a 2-star wanted level, but pull it off successfully and Patrick 'Packie' McReary becomes available for your heist crew. Knock out 14 random events total for 100% completion.

items.title: Mugging 1
items.description: All characters can do this one where you kill the thief and either return the victim's cash or pocket it yourself, and any 14 random events count toward 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 1
items.description: Open to all three characters and finishing 14 random events chips away at your progress toward 100% completion.

items.title: ATM Robbery
items.description: Works with everyone and you drop the thief then decide whether to give back the victim's money or take it, with any 14 random events pushing you closer to 100% completion.

items.title: Luring Girl Into Alley
items.description: Any character can handle this and the girl lures you into an alleyway for an ambush so take down both her and the attacker to finish it. Complete 14 random events for 100% progress.

items.title: Security Van 10
items.description: Open to everyone and knocking out 14 random events gains you progress toward 100% completion.

items.title: Chase Thieves City 2
items.description: Any character can do this where you waste the thieves and either return the victim's cash or keep it for yourself, and finishing 14 random events counts toward 100% completion.

items.title: Simeon Yetarian
items.description: Only Michael and Franklin can trigger this one and it only appears between Friend Request and The Jewel Store Job missions when you walk into the dealership. Any 14 random events contribute to 100% completion.

items.title: ATM Robbery
items.description: All characters work here and you take down the thief then choose to give back the victim's money or just pocket it, with 14 random events needed for 100% completion progress.

items.title: Mugging 3
items.description: Works with any character and you kill the thief to either return the victim's cash or stash it yourself, and completing 14 random events helps push toward 100% completion.

items.title: Construction Accident
items.description: Any character can do this and tubes collapsed onto a truck trapping a worker inside so grab the excavator and clear the tubes off the driver's door before the fire kills him. Finish 14 random events for 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 6
items.description: All characters can trigger this and completing 14 random events moves you toward 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 2
items.description: Open to everyone and completing 14 random events gains you progress toward 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 4
items.description: All three characters can handle this one, and finishing any 14 random events will count toward your 100% completion.

items.title: ATM Robbery
items.description: Works with any character. Chase down the thief and you get to choose whether you want to return the money to the victim or just keep it, and completing any 14 random events moves you closer to 100% completion.

items.title: Drunk Driver 1
items.description: Any character can jump in but if you're playing Trevor you can drop them at the Altruist Camp for some quick money, and finishing any 14 random events helps chip away at 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 5
items.description: All characters can trigger this and completing any 14 random events will push you toward 100% completion.

items.title: Shop Robbery 2
items.description: Any character works here so kill the thieves and then decide if you want to return the stolen goods or keep them for yourself, and knocking out any 14 random events brings you closer to 100% completion.

items.title: Border Patrol 2
items.description: Works with any character and you'll run into three dirt bikers who start messing with you along this road so take all of them out to wrap things up, and finishing any 14 random events counts toward 100% completion.

items.title: Bike Thief City 2
items.description: All three characters can handle this so drop the thief and bring the bike back to boost your driving skill or just keep it, and completing any 14 random events makes progress on 100% completion.

items.title: Mugging 2
items.description: Any character can jump on this one so kill the thief and either return the cash or stuff it in your own pocket, and finishing any 14 random events inches you toward 100% completion.

items.title: Chase Thieves City 1
items.description: Works with all characters so waste the thieves and choose to give the money back or keep it for yourself, and knocking out any 14 random events contributes toward 100% completion.

items.title: Escape Paparazzi
items.description: Any character can trigger this so let the celebrity hop in and get ready for a chase then drop her off at home, but don't kill any paparazzi or you'll blow the whole event, and completing any 14 random events pushes you toward 100% completion.

items.title: Bus Tour
items.description: All characters work here so swing by between 7:00 and 19:00 to catch the tour bus, pay up, watch or skip the tour and you're done, and finishing any 14 random events makes progress on 100% completion.

items.title: Monkey Mosaic
items.description: Any character works but only on next-gen versions so first snap photos of all 50 Monkey Mosaics and buy at least two garages, then a guy shows up here painting a wall and you snap a pic of him to finish the event, plus you get a Go-Go Monkey Blista spawning in your garage afterward, and completing any 14 random events works toward 100% completion.

items.title: Shop Robbery 1
items.description: Works with all characters on next-gen only so kill the thieves and either return what they stole or pocket it yourself, and finishing any 14 random events chips away at 100% completion.

items.title: Domestic
items.description: Any character can handle this so just give the guy a ride to the golf club, and completing any 14 random events moves you closer to 100% completion.

items.title: Snatched
items.description: All characters can trigger this so you'll see two kidnappers dragging a woman into a van, shoot out the tires, kill both guys without hitting her, then drive her home while fighting off more attackers along the way, or if you're playing Trevor take her to the Altruist Camp instead for cash, and knocking out any 14 random events counts toward 100% completion.

items.title: Sport Bike Thief
items.description: Works with any character so kill the thief and bring the bike back to level up your driving or just keep the bike, and finishing any 14 random events pushes you toward 100% completion.

items.title: Hitch Lift 1
items.description: Any character works here so drive this passenger to the airport and he'll give you the Tinkle Stock Tip which jumps 30% afterward, and completing any 14 random events works toward 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 8
items.description: Works with all characters and knocking out any 14 random events makes progress on 100% completion.

items.title: Rogue Altruists
items.description: Franklin and Michael only so waste the Altruists, rescue the woman, and drop her off at home for $80, and completing any 14 random events pushes you toward 100% completion.

items.title: Border Patrol 1
items.description: Any character can trigger this and three dirt bikers might start harassing you on this stretch so take them all down to finish the event, and completing any 14 random events contributes toward 100% completion.

items.title: Sea Plane
items.description: This one only works on next-gen consoles and any character can do it. When you get to the cove some enemies will be hanging around a plane so grab it and take off, then more enemies show up in boats but just keep going and get out of there to wrap it up. Knocking out any 14 Random Events counts toward 100% completion progress.

items.title: Arrests 2
items.description: Any character can trigger this event where a cop is chasing down a criminal and you have to pick a side. If you take out the cop the criminal pays you $250 but you get 3 wanted stars, or you can stun gun the criminal to help the cop instead. Finish any 14 Random Events to count toward 100% completion.

items.title: Abandoned Vehicle 2
items.description: Works with any character so head to the wind farm and find the shaking RV. The moment you get close they attack so have your gun ready and take them down to wrap this up. Complete any 14 Random Events for 100% completion progress.

items.title: Prisoner Lift 1
items.description: Franklin and Michael can handle this one where an escaped prisoner needs a ride. Give him a lift but expect some police trouble along the way. Any 14 Random Events count toward 100% completion.

items.title: Prisoner Lift 2
items.description: Any character works here and an escaped prisoner begs for help then immediately tries jacking your car. Finish any 14 Random Events to move closer to 100% completion.

items.title: Stag Do Running Man
items.description: Open to all characters so untie the guy and drive him home so he can change, then rush him to his wedding before the clock runs out. Knock out any 14 Random Events for 100% completion progress.

items.title: Hitch Lift 4
items.description: Any character can do this where the runaway bride needs a lift home. On the return trip her fiancé rams your car so pull over, get out and knock him out with your fists but don't kill him, then drive her home and your driving skill goes up by 5. Complete any 14 Random Events to push toward 100% completion.

items.title: Countryside Robbery
items.description: Works with any character so roll up to the motel where cops are in a shootout with thieves. The first robber drops money when he gets shot so grab it, then take down the second one for his briefcase and lose the cops. Any 14 Random Events contribute to 100% completion.

items.title: Duel
items.description: Any character works but only on next-gen versions, and there's a unique armored muscle car here called the Duke o' Death. Try to steal it and two trucks will block the road while enemies chase you down as you escape. Finish any 14 Random Events for 100% completion progress.

items.title: Chase Thieves Country 2
items.description: Open to all characters where you take out the bikers and either return the stolen cash or pocket it yourself. Complete any 14 Random Events to work toward 100% completion.

items.title: Abandoned Vehicle 1
items.description: Any character can trigger this so walk up to the vehicle and you'll get stunned, then next thing you know you're waking up on train tracks. Kill your attacker to finish the event and your car will still be exactly where you left it before getting kidnapped. Knock out any 14 Random Events for 100% completion progress.

items.title: Countryside Gang Fight
items.description: Franklin and Michael only where you rescue the guy being held at gunpoint and wipe out the gang, then they pay you $1000 for the save. Any 14 Random Events count toward 100% completion.

items.title: Drunk Driver 2
items.description: Works with any character and the couple outside the restaurant on Armadillo Avenue needs a ride. Take them home in their car and they give you $80, or as Trevor drop them at the Altruist Camp instead for cash. Finish any 14 Random Events to move closer to 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 7
items.description: Any character can do this. Complete any 14 Random Events to contribute toward 100% completion.

items.title: Hitch Lift 3
items.description: Open to all characters where she wants a ride to her boyfriend's place in Vinewood Hills. When you get there prepare for a fight with her boyfriend and his guard but you earn 5 driving skill points, or playing as Trevor deliver her to the Altruist Camp for cash instead. Knock out any 14 Random Events for 100% completion progress.

items.title: Arrests 1
items.description: Any character works here and a cop is chasing a criminal so time to pick a side. Kill the cop and the criminal gives you $250 though you get 3 wanted stars, or help the cop by stunning the criminal. Complete any 14 Random Events to push toward 100% completion.

items.title: Chase Thieves Country 1
items.description: Works with any character where four gangsters just robbed someone so chase them down and get the wallet back. Keep it for $250 or return it and only get $25. Any 14 Random Events contribute to 100% completion.

items.title: Drug Shootout
items.description: Trevor only can break up a drug deal happening here. Inside the shed there's a briefcase worth $30k to $70k so grab it and go, and this spot resets every week or two so you can hit it again though some players report it stops resetting eventually or takes forever to come back. Finish any 14 Random Events for 100% completion progress.

items.title: Crash Rescue
items.description: Any character can do this but only after finishing the first heist, so rush this woman home before she bleeds out. Get her there in time and she joins your crew as a getaway driver with excellent driving and high composure though vehicle choice is her weak point. Best part is she only takes a 5% cut making her perfect for saving money while keeping a solid driver on your team. Complete any 14 Random Events to work toward 100% completion.

items.title: Hitch Lift 2
items.description: Open to all characters where Ursula is on North Calafia Way waiting for a ride. Drop her off at home and you get 5 driving skill points plus her phone number, or as Trevor take her to the Altruist Camp instead for cash. Knock out any 14 Random Events for 100% completion progress.

items.title: Border Patrol 3
items.description: Any character can trigger this. Three dirt bikers roll up on you along this road and you need to take all of them down to complete it. Finishing any 14 random events counts toward your 100% completion.

items.title: Car Theft 1
items.description: Any character works for this one. Return the car and you'll boost your driving skill. Completing any 14 random events counts toward your 100% completion.

items.title: Deal Gone Wrong
items.description: This works with any character. When you show up you'll see wrecked trucks and bodies everywhere, then follow the markers to track down a dying guy clutching a briefcase with $25,000 inside. Watch out because a gang jumps you when you try to leave. Getting through any 14 random events counts toward your 100% completion.

items.title: Security Van 3
items.description: Any character can do this but you need to arrive after 9pm or it won't spawn. The target walks out from the building on the south corner so just run him over and snag the money. The truck and second guy aren't worth bothering with unless you really want to. Clearing any 14 random events counts toward your 100% completion.

items.title: ATM Robbery
items.description: This works for any character. Kill the thief and you can either return the stolen cash to the victim or keep it for yourself. Finishing any 14 random events counts toward your 100% completion.

items.title: Burial
items.description: Any character can handle this. You'll find two guys trying to bury a woman alive so take both of them out and drive her home safely to score a $60,000 reward. If you're playing as Trevor you can deliver her to the Altruist Camp instead but you'll get way less money. Completing any 14 random events counts toward your 100% completion.

items.title: Josh (1) - Extra Commission
items.description: Playing as Trevor, Josh wants you to destroy 15 Lenny Avery Realty signs spread throughout the city, and there are no gold medal requirements for this one.

items.title: Dom (2) - Liquidity Risk
items.description: This mission has you playing as Franklin and going for two gold medal requirements: Dive Bomber means you need to hit the water without opening your parachute and survive, while Sky Blazer requires pulling off 8 flips on the Blazer.

items.title: Barry (5) - Grass Roots - The Drag
items.description: Franklin runs this mission and for gold you need to keep that car hooked the whole way through without letting it come loose, plus finish everything in 1 minute and 30 seconds.

items.title: Rampage (3) - Ballas
items.description: This is Trevor's mission where you need to rack up 50 kills total, land 6 clean headshots, and take out 2 vehicles to get the gold medal.

items.title: Tonya (3) - Pulling Favors Again
items.description: Franklin handles this one but you need to finish Pulling Another Favor first then call Tonya to start it. Gold requirements are beating the mission in 7 minutes and keeping the vehicle hooked all the way to delivery without unhooking it.

items.title: Tonya (4) - Still Pulling Favors
items.description: After wrapping up Pulling Favors Again, ring Tonya as Franklin to get this mission started. You need to finish within 6 minutes and deliver the vehicle without unhooking it once to earn gold.

items.title: Tonya (5) - Pulling One Last Favor
items.description: Franklin takes on Tonya's final mission once you complete Still Pulling Favors. Call her to begin and aim to finish in 5 minutes while keeping that hook locked until delivery for the gold medal.

items.title: Tonya (2) - Pulling Another Favor
items.description: Franklin's mission requires you to clear it in 5 minutes and 30 seconds while making sure you don't unhook the vehicle before delivery to grab gold.

items.title: Tonya (1) - Pulling Favors
items.description: Playing as Franklin, you need to wrap this up in 5 minutes or less and keep that vehicle hooked the entire way without unhooking to hit gold requirements.

items.title: Nigel (7) - The Last Act
items.description: Trevor's mission gives you gold if you bail out right before the train hits the car and let the train handle Al Di Napoli instead of doing it yourself.

items.title: Hao - Shift Work
items.description: Trevor races here and you need to hit a lap time under 1 minute 20 seconds, cross the finish line within 2 minutes 50 seconds, and keep collisions under 5 for gold. Beating this unlocks Street Races.

items.title: Rampage (2) - Vagos
items.description: Trevor's mission asks you to pile up 45 kills, score 6 headshots, and blow up 2 vehicles for the gold medal.

items.title: Josh (2) - Closing the Deal
items.description: As Trevor, work Avery over with a melee weapon and stop his car in 40 seconds or less to earn gold on this mission.

items.title: Josh (3) - Surreal Estate
items.description: Trevor needs to get through without triggering the cops and lay the gas trail perfectly on the first try to score gold here.

items.title: Barry (4) - Grass Roots - The Pickup
items.description: Franklin's mission requires finishing in 2 minutes and 45 seconds without picking up any wanted level to earn gold.

items.title: Barry (3) - Grass Roots - Franklin
items.description: Franklin handles this mission after you complete Three's Company. There are no gold medal requirements.

items.title: Barry (1) - Grass Roots - Michael
items.description: Michael takes this mission once you finish Complications and Tonya's Pulling Favors. For gold you need to take minimal damage to your health and armor and drop 7 aliens in 10 seconds for the kill chain.

items.title: Barry (2) - Grass Roots - Trevor
items.description: Complete Three's Company first then Trevor can start this mission. Gold requires blowing up 4 clown vans before they spawn any clowns and taking down 6 clowns while they're dancing.

items.title: Dom (3) - Targeted Risk
items.description: Franklin freefalls for 8 seconds before pulling the chute and nails the landing right on the truck bed to earn gold.

items.title: Beverly (5) - The Highness
items.description: Franklin needs to get the photo without being spotted and catch the princess making the drug buy on camera for gold.

items.title: Rampage (5) - Hipsters
items.description: Trevor's mission requires notching 30 kills, getting 10 headshots, and destroying 2 vehicles for gold.

items.title: Dom (4) - Uncalculated Risk
items.description: Franklin needs to knock out all 13 Parachute Jumps first then this mission opens up. Gold requires following Dom off the edge and surviving the drop.

items.title: Epsilon (5) - Bearing the Truth
items.description: Play as Michael after you finish Chasing the Truth and drop $10,000 through epsilonprogram.com. There are no gold medal requirements for this one. Just be careful not to swap characters or do anything that changes Michael's outfit because it resets the 10-day countdown, and sleeping at his house will speed things up.

items.title: Barry (6) - Grass Roots - The Smoke-In
items.description: Play as Franklin with no gold medal requirements.

items.title: Beverly (4) - The Meltdown
items.description: Franklin handles this one and there are two gold requirements to nail. Stay glued to Poppy through the entire chase for Thick of it, and make sure you snap the photo after she's already in handcuffs to get DUI Diva.

items.title: Epsilon (2) - Accepting the Truth
items.description: You need Michael for this mission after finishing Seeking the Truth and donating $500 via epsilonprogram.com. No gold medal requirements here.

items.title: Beverly (2) - The Sex Tape
items.description: Franklin takes the lead and two gold medals are up for grabs. Dive into the pool while you're tailing Beverly to get Quick Dip, and lock in full facial recognition during the chase for Money Shot.

items.title: Beverly (1) - Paparazzo
items.description: This one has Franklin working with Beverly on two gold requirements. Make sure Beverly knocks out his rival on the first try for Smack Down, then help him capture and review 3 photos to unlock Picture Perfect.

items.title: Beverly (3) - The Partnership
items.description: Franklin runs this mission with no gold medal requirements.

items.title: Beverly (6) - Reality Check
items.description: Franklin gets one gold medal chance here called Explosive Action where you need to wipe out Beverly and his entire crew with a single shot.

items.title: Nigel (2) - Vinewood Souvenirs - Willie
items.description: Trevor handles this one with two gold requirements to chase. Hang out with the manager and groupies upstairs at the club for Entourage, then beat Willie without taking a single hit to score Fist Fury.

items.title: Epsilon (8) - Unknowing the Truth
items.description: Michael needs at least $50,000 and the Epsilon Robes equipped before starting this mission. Two gold medals are waiting if you take down all Epsilon security for Cult Intervention and grab the Epsilon cash before escaping to get Show me the Money.

items.title: Nigel (4) - Vinewood Souvenirs - Kerry
items.description: Trevor runs this one with a single gold requirement called Hot on the Paws where you need to keep up with Dexie the entire way without falling behind.

items.title: Nigel (6) - Vinewood Souvenirs - Al Di Napoli
items.description: Play as Trevor and chase three different gold medals. Don't lose Al Di Napoli during the chase for Stalker, avoid hitting anyone inside the hospital to get Accident and Emergency, and keep Nigel's car damage to a minimum for Not a Scratch.

items.title: Mary-Ann (1) - Exercising Demons - Michael
items.description: Michael takes this one after you wrap up Complications and Tonya's first mission Pulling Favors. Win the race without cutting any corners to grab the Contender gold medal.

items.title: Nigel (5) - Vinewood Souvenirs - Mark
items.description: Trevor handles this between 7:00 and 20:00 only. Three gold medals are available if you grab the golf club in under 30 seconds for Under Par, drop Mark with a headshot for Hole in One, and kill Mark plus his 3 bodyguards to get Four.

items.title: Josh (4) - Breach of Contract

items.title: Nigel (3) - Vinewood Souvenirs - Tyler
items.description: Play as Trevor and chase two gold medals by stealth-killing the Gardener for Weed Killer and grabbing the clothes without getting spotted to unlock Pilferer.

items.title: A Starlet in Vinewood
items.description: Franklin can start this after collecting all 50 Letter Scraps. One gold medal is waiting if you end Dreyfuss to get Cut.

items.title: Nigel (1) - Nigel and Mrs. Thornhill
items.description: Trevor runs this mission with no gold medal requirements.

items.title: Dom (1) - Risk Assessment
items.description: Franklin takes this one after beating the Minor Turbulence mission. Three gold medals are up for grabs if you drop for 7 seconds before popping the chute for Free Faller, get 2 seconds of airtime during the bike race for Big Air, and beat Dom in the bicycle race to score Downhill King.

items.title: Mary-Ann (3) - Exercising Demons - Trevor
items.description: Trevor handles this after finishing Reuniting the Family. Two gold medals are waiting if you keep your bike under control without crashing into Mary Ann for Good Cyclist and cross the finish line in under 01:42 to get Quick Win.

items.title: Rampage (4) - Military
items.description: You play as Trevor and need to rack up 45 kills total while landing 6 headshots and destroying 2 tanks to get gold.

items.title: Epsilon (6) - Delivering the Truth
items.description: Michael takes the lead here and you need to stick the Velum landing without taking any damage, plus fly under a bridge along Lago Zancudo to nail the gold requirements.

items.title: Epsilon (1) - Seeking the Truth
items.description: This mission has Michael at the helm and you need to wrap up Father/Son and Pulling Favors first, then complete the Epsilon Program Identity Evaluation over at epsilonprogram.com before it unlocks, though there are no gold medal requirements to worry about.

items.title: The Last One
items.description: Franklin handles this one but it only shows up after you hit 100% completion, and for gold you need to hit the Sasquatch 3 times before catching it, take down 4 animals during the chase, and walk to the scat site on foot instead of driving.

items.title: Death at Sea
items.description: Michael kicks this off after you finish Blitz Play and buy the Sonar Collections Dock, and while there are no gold requirements any character can jump in and collect the submarine parts once the mission starts.

items.title: What Lies Beneath
items.description: You play as Michael and this mission becomes available once you wrap up Death at Sea by collecting all 30 Submarine Pieces, though there are no gold medal requirements attached.

items.title: Cletus (2) - Fair Game
items.description: Trevor takes this hunt and you need to stay completely undetected by all the elk while dropping 3 of them with heart shots to earn gold.

items.title: Mary-Ann (2) - Exercising Demons - Franklin
items.description: Franklin handles the wheel after you beat Predator first, and the only gold requirement is winning the race without taking any shortcuts.

items.title: Minute Men (3) - Minute Man Blues
items.description: Trevor runs this operation and for gold you have to stun gun Joe and Josef before you finish them off, plus take them both down before they escape the farm.

items.title: Minute Men (2) - An American Welcome
items.description: You control Trevor and getting gold means stopping the first group in 30 seconds or less, shutting down the second group within 55 seconds, and using only the stun gun to stop everyone.

items.title: Minute Men (1) - The Civil Border Patrol
items.description: Trevor takes charge and you need to stun the band then steal their Tornado while shutting down the band in 40 seconds to secure gold.

items.title: Epsilon (7) - Exercising the Truth
items.description: Michael walks this one and there are no gold requirements, but if you wander out of the desert your progress resets completely.

items.title: Mrs. Philips (2) - Damaged Goods
items.description: Trevor handles this mission without any gold requirements and Deludamol vans spawn all over Los Santos, so if you don't see one at the marked spot try checking the hospitals.

items.title: Rampage (1) - Rednecks
items.description: You play as Trevor and need to score 45 kills with 3 headshots and blow up 2 vehicles for gold.

items.title: Cletus (1) - Target Practice
items.description: Trevor runs this challenge and for gold you need to drop 2 coyotes with a single shot, shoot all 3 tires at 75% accuracy or better, and destroy all 3 satellite dishes without missing.

items.title: Mrs. Philips (1)
items.description: Trevor gets this mission but it only unlocks after you finish the main story with ending B or ending C, and there are no gold medal requirements.

items.title: Omega (1) - Far Out
items.description: Franklin takes over once you finish Fame or Shame and this mission has no gold requirements to chase.

items.title: Omega (2) - The Final Frontier
items.description: Franklin handles this after you collect all 50 Spaceship Parts and while there are no gold requirements you should drive the space buggy straight to a garage to save it in your collection.

items.title: Maude - Special Bonds
items.description: Trevor gets four Bail Bond Missions from Maude and bringing the targets back alive scores bigger payouts, though there are no gold requirements for any of them.

items.title: Epsilon (4) - Chasing the Truth
items.description: Michael runs this mission and the only gold requirement is tracking down the alien artifact without using the detector, but be careful because switching to first person auto-equips the detector and kills your gold run.

items.title: Epsilon (3) - Assuming the Truth
items.description: Playing as Michael, you need to finish the Accepting the Truth mission first, then donate $5000 on the epsilonprogram.com website. After that you can start this mission which has no gold medal requirements. Your job is to round up five specific vehicles and bring them in: a Pegassi Vacca, Benefactor Surano, Declasse Tornado, Enus Super Diamond, and Dinka Double-T.

items.title: Hidden Package #6

The Nagasaki Dinghy has built-in scuba gear which makes collecting packages much easier, just search for Dinghy in the search feature to find it.

items.title: Hidden Package #8
items.description: This briefcase is worth $11,000 but there's a bug where hidden packages sometimes don't spawn properly. If yours is missing just quick save and reload and it'll appear. Grab yourself a Nagasaki Dinghy to make collection easier since it comes with scuba gear, you can use the search feature to find one fast.

items.title: Hidden Package #7
items.description: You'll find $7500 in this briefcase but packages aren't always appearing lately due to a spawn issue. If it's not there when you arrive quick save and reload to fix it. The Nagasaki Dinghy makes this way easier because it has scuba equipment built in, just search 'Dinghy' to locate one nearby.

items.title: Hidden Package #5
items.description: Check under the left wheel of the paddle boat for this one. Sometimes these don't appear because of a known bug so quick save then reload if you're not seeing it. Use a Nagasaki Dinghy with scuba gear for underwater pickups and search 'Dinghy' to find one.

items.title: Hidden Package #4
items.description: There's a $20,000 briefcase inside the upper hole of the ship but hidden packages have been glitching recently. Can't find it? Quick save and reload to make it appear. The easiest method is using the Nagasaki Dinghy since it comes with scuba equipment, just search for 'Dinghy' using the app's search feature.

items.title: Hidden Package #3
items.description: This $10,000 briefcase is hiding in the sunken semi-trailer and it's really hard to spot. Bonus for you though, tons of weapons and armor are scattered around the nearby tanks and army trucks. Packages aren't spawning consistently so quick save and reload if it's missing. Grab a Nagasaki Dinghy for the scuba gear and search 'Dinghy' to track one down.

items.title: Hidden Package #2
items.description: The $8000 briefcase is beneath the crop duster bi-plane but sharks always spawn here so kill them before you dive. Get in, grab it, get out fast or you're shark food. If the package isn't there quick save and reload because of the spawn bug. Use the Nagasaki Dinghy with scuba equipment and search 'Dinghy' in the app to find one.

items.title: Hidden Package #12
items.description: This sunken plane has a $12,000 briefcase that respawns if you're fast enough. Grab it then immediately switch characters and swap back, if you're quick the briefcase reappears and you can farm it repeatedly. Running low on air? Character swap resets your oxygen bar to full. Packages sometimes don't show because of a bug so quick save and reload to fix it. The Nagasaki Dinghy has scuba gear so search 'Dinghy' to find one.

items.title: Hidden Package #1
items.description: Four briefcases worth $25,000 each but these only spawn after Trevor delivers four victims to the Altruist camp. Grab all four right then because this is your one and only chance to collect them, miss it and they're gone forever.

items.title: Hidden Package #11
items.description: Look for the $12,500 briefcase tucked inside the plane's tail section. Hidden packages have been inconsistent lately so if you're not seeing it quick save and reload. The Nagasaki Dinghy with scuba gear makes this simple, just search 'Dinghy' to locate one nearby.

items.title: Hidden Package #10
items.description: The $9000 briefcase is sitting on top of the sunken tugboat with plenty of weapons and armor scattered on the seafloor nearby. Watch for occasional sharks around here. This one respawns so collect it, save your game, reload, and grab it again for easy cash. If the package isn't appearing quick save and reload because of the bug. Nagasaki Dinghy with scuba equipment is your best tool, search 'Dinghy' in the app to find one.

items.title: Hidden Package #9
items.description: Check the oil tank from the sunken tanker loading pier for this $25,000 briefcase. There's an RPG on the seafloor right south of the case plus loads of weapons and armor around the area. This respawns every time so save, reload, and collect again for unlimited money. Packages sometimes won't spawn because of a known bug so quick save and reload to fix it. Nagasaki Dinghy for the scuba equipment is recommended, just search 'Dinghy' to find one.

items.title: Stunt Jump #22

items.title: Stunt Jump #23

items.title: Stunt Jump #24

items.title: Stunt Jump #26

items.title: Stunt Jump #27

items.title: Stunt Jump #28

items.title: Stunt Jump #32

items.title: Stunt Jump #33

items.title: Stunt Jump #34

items.title: Stunt Jump #35

items.title: Stunt Jump #36
items.description: You need to floor it off this trailer ramp or you're going to crash right into the side of the building. Sometimes this jump bugs out and won't register even when you nail the landing perfectly, so just keep trying until it finally counts. Bring a fast car or a fully tuned bike.

items.title: Stunt Jump #37

items.title: Stunt Jump #47

items.title: Stunt Jump #48

items.title: Stunt Jump #49

items.title: Stunt Jump #50

items.title: Spaceship Part #1
items.description: Head to the back of Hangar number one at LS International Airport and grab it from next to the blue dumpster. Just a heads up, if you don't own a hangar here the cops arrive instantly. A helicopter or car works best for getting here.

items.title: Spaceship Part #2
items.description: Jump in the water southeast of the Merryweather HQ dock and swim down to the rusted iron boat wreck where the part is waiting.

items.title: Spaceship Part #3
items.description: At the LS State Gas Company you'll see two dome-shaped Coke Storage containers connected by a black pipe. Climb up and check dead center on top of that pipe.

items.title: Spaceship Part #4
items.description: Head south from Elysian Fields Freeway down to the beach and look around the gate covering a storm drain pipe.

items.title: Spaceship Part #5
items.description: There's a little rocky island off the coast south of Murrieta Oil Fields and the part is just sitting there.

items.title: Spaceship Part #6
items.description: Find the green shipping container pushed up against the building and walk inside since it's already open.

items.title: Spaceship Part #7
items.description: Walk through the entrance and take a right, then check at the base of one of the sculptures. Going on foot or by car works fine.

items.title: Spaceship Part #8
items.description: Fly your helicopter up to the roof of Central Los Santos Medical Center and land on the helipads, then walk over to the southwestern corner.

items.title: Spaceship Part #9
items.description: Go under Olympic Freeway on the west side of Elgin Ave where the homeless camp is set up. The part is next to the couch just east of a small power station.

items.title: Spaceship Part #10
items.description: Find the Liquor Hole store at the southeast edge of Vespucci Canals and take the ladder in back all the way up to the scaffolding between two billboards where the part sits at the very top.

items.title: Spaceship Part #11
items.description: Take the walkways and ladders down to the center divider of the river dam and grab it from there.

items.title: Spaceship Part #12
items.description: On the east side of Simmet Alley Market slip into the alley running between Bean Machine and SND Textiles.

items.title: Spaceship Part #13
items.description: Bring a helicopter to the Penris building rooftop and once you land check directly behind the sign at the front.

items.title: Spaceship Part #14
items.description: Go underground at the Metro Station construction site by entering through the tunnel off the eastbound lane of Del Perro Freeway under Alta Street. Once you're down there look for the dust curtain and the part is nearby, same spot as that hard to find Online Gang Attack.

items.title: Spaceship Part #15
items.description: Go to the middle level of Rockford Plaza and look for the grassy area on the West side right next to where the upper parking driveway runs. A car or helicopter works best for getting there.

items.title: Spaceship Part #16
items.description: Fly up to the hotel roof next door to LS Customs where you'll find the part sitting in a drained pool. You'll need a helicopter to reach it.

items.title: Spaceship Part #17
items.description: There's a long water pool running along the right side of the 7th Hole fairway at LS Golf Club with a small island in the middle where the part sits.

items.title: Spaceship Part #18
items.description: Walk into the Richards Majestic Movie Studio back lot just NorthEast of the Stage 13/14 building and climb up one of the Spanish villas using the stairs, then scale the wall at the end to reach the third floor roof where the part sits beside a lumber pile on what looks like a fourth floor balcony. Just know that entering the lot gives you a 2 Star wanted level if you haven't finished certain missions yet, so go on foot.

items.title: Spaceship Part #19
items.description: Dive underwater beneath the west side of the Land Act Dam dock to find the part down below.

items.title: Spaceship Part #20
items.description: You'll find the part sitting right at the opening of a large drainage pipe.

items.title: Spaceship Part #21
items.description: There's a small beach sitting beside the large rock arch formation where you can grab the part.

items.title: Spaceship Part #22
items.description: Dive into the cove on the eastern side and swim down to find the part underwater inside. A heli, boat, or just walking there all work fine.

items.title: Spaceship Part #23
items.description: Swim down to the support column of the Vinewood Lake Dam where the part sits underwater next to it.

items.title: Spaceship Part #24
items.description: Climb up the right side stairs at the Galileo Observatory to reach the roof where you'll spot the part on the eastern side, and if you're flying a helicopter you can land directly next to it.

items.title: Spaceship Part #24
items.description: Climb up the right side stairs at the Galileo Observatory to reach the roof where you'll spot the part on the eastern side, and if you're flying a helicopter you can land directly next to it.

items.title: Spaceship Part #26
items.description: The part sits next to a tree in front of the main house at the drug recovery facility.

items.title: Spaceship Part #27
items.description: Walk into the cave next to the river and you'll find the part inside.

items.title: Spaceship Part #28
items.description: Outside this house overlooking the mountainside there's a small pad with a telescope and the part sits right beside it.

items.title: Spaceship Part #29
items.description: Walk between the grape vines and you'll find the spaceship part in there.

items.title: Spaceship Part #30
items.description: The part floats in the water almost under the bridge between the large waterfall and the smaller one.

items.title: Spaceship Part #31
items.description: Walk around to the back porch of the building near the barn where the spaceship part sits.

items.title: Spaceship Part #32
items.description: North of this road you need to drop down the cliff next to the rock face to find the part below.

items.title: Spaceship Part #33
items.description: The spaceship part sits waiting in the back garden of the house.

items.title: Spaceship Part #34
items.description: Look under the southern side of the bridge to find the spaceship part.

items.title: Spaceship Part #35
items.description: You'll only see this one from above since it's stuck on the tiniest ledge imaginable, so bring a helicopter with you.

items.title: Spaceship Part #36
items.description: Look for the flat ground that's tucked between the small cliffs by the river.

items.title: Spaceship Part #37
items.description: This one is on the ground right next to the boat on the port side.

items.title: Spaceship Part #38
items.description: Go to the westernmost dish, climb your way up, and you'll find it sitting on the rampart.

items.title: Spaceship Part #39
items.description: There's a ledge under the east side of that big rock where the part is sitting.

items.title: Spaceship Part #40
items.description: Underwater.

items.description: Near the San Chainski Mountains in Cape Catfish you'll want to look inside the boathouse that's next to the pier.

items.title: Spaceship Part #43
items.description: You'll find this one out in the open near a cowshed on the Grapeseed ranch.

items.title: Spaceship Part #44
items.description: Check the floor inside the shed.

items.title: Spaceship Part #45
items.description: In Cassidy Creek there's an island in the river between the big waterfall and the sloped rapids, and the part is under the train bridge on that island.

items.title: Spaceship Part #46
items.description: This one is underneath the bridge on the sea side just north of center on the southernmost arch. If you're careful enough you can land a helicopter right next to it on the underside of the bridge, otherwise just parachute in.

items.title: Spaceship Part #47
items.description: At Paleto Beach there's a tiny peninsula just offshore where the part is hiding.

items.title: Spaceship Part #48
items.description: In Paleto Forest near Highway One you'll want to check the culvert on the low gentle slope.

items.title: Spaceship Part #49
items.description: Go inside the Fire Fighting Exercise Tower in Paleto Bay and head up to the third floor.

items.title: Spaceship Part #50
items.description: At the Donkey Punch farm in Paleto Bay go around to the back of the big run-down barn.

items.title: Fort Zancudo Military Base
items.description: The US Army base is stocked with vehicles but completely overrun with elite soldiers who don't mess around. Storm the place and you're in for a brutal firefight, then the instant you step outside you'll have a 5-star wanted level slapped on you, so make sure you're fully geared before you try anything.

items.title: Rebel Radio Station Base

items.title: Los Santos International Airport
items.description: Los Santos International Airport sits west of the Port and south of La Puerta with three total runways, one on the northwest side for smaller business jets and two on the south for the big commercial planes. It's based on Los Angeles International Airport and this is the first HD-universe game where commercial jets actually take off and land on their own plus you can fully pilot those massive Boeing 747s yourself. All three characters can hit up the flight school here to improve their flying skills, and there are two unique jumps hidden around the airport with small ramps that tilt up to 90 degrees. Just be careful because entering the airport triggers an automatic 3-star wanted level unless you own a hangar there.

items.title: Hotel
items.description: A high-end hotel that draws inspiration from the actual Hotel Casa Del Mar at 1910 Ocean Way in Santa Monica.

items.title: Prosperity Street Promenade
items.description: Del Perro's shopping center is loaded with places to check out including Astro Theaters and Dionysia Theaters for entertainment, food spots like Al Dente's, The Fish Net, Lettuce Be, Nutsaki, and Taco Bomb, plus a ton of shops such as Alphabetz, Derriere, DidierSachs, Double Denim, Heroin Chic, Lârs&Elbö, Lézard, Miss T, Peckerwood, Pharaoh, Ranch Jeans, Scarper, Spines Bookstore, Suburban, White Widow, UniversalUniform, and ZiP. The whole place is modeled after Santa Monica's Third Street Promenade.

items.title: The Jetty
items.description: These upscale condos and apartments mirror the real building at 101 Ocean Ave in Santa Monica.

items.title: Crastenburg Hotel
items.description: A Pacific Bluffs luxury hotel that takes its design cues from Ocean Towers at 201 Ocean Ave in Santa Monica.

items.title: Von Crastenburg Hotel
items.description: This high-end hotel pulls its look from Ocean Towers over at 201 Ocean Ave in Santa Monica.

items.title: The Archipelago
items.description: Rockford Hills has this luxury hotel with an Enema store tucked inside, and it's based on The Peninsula at 9882 S Santa Monica Blvd in Beverly Hills.

items.title: Life Invader Building
items.description: Life Invader Corporation runs San Andreas's take on a social networking site.

items.title: Von Crastenburg Richman
items.description: The Von Crastenburg sits in Richman and mimics the Beverly Hilton at 9876 Wilshire Blvd in Beverly Hills.

items.title: The Richman Hotel
items.description: The Richman Hotel draws from the Beverly Hills Hotel at 9641 Sunset Blvd in Beverly Hills for its design.

items.title: De Santa Residence (Michael's House)
items.description: The De Santa family calls this place home with Michael, Amanda, Jimmy, and Tracey all living here. You get a two-car garage, swimming pool, tennis court, and a walk-in wardrobe. Grab a drink yourself or have the maid make one to restore health, launch various missions from the property, and use the pool or do some yoga.

items.title: Epsilon Center
items.description: Epsilon Program runs their headquarters here and the building copies the Church of Scientology Celebrity Centre International at 5930 Franklin Ave in Los Angeles.

items.title: Rockford Hills City Hall
items.description: Rockford Hills uses this as their City Hall and it's based on Beverly Hills City Hall at 455 N Rexford Dr in Beverly Hills.

items.title: Rockford Plaza
items.description: Burton's biggest shopping hub is loaded with places to eat and shop. You can hit up restaurants like Bite!, Café Austère, Les Bianco, Viendemorte, or Vinewood Café, then check out stores including Bull Emic, Croq-a-Hoop, Derriere, DidierSachs, Fuque, Guido Zenitalia, Gutter&Blood, Lézard, MyMy, Ranch, Tim Vapid, White Widow, or Val-de-Grâce. This place is based on the real Beverly Center at 8500 Beverly Blvd in Los Angeles.

items.title: The Generic Hotel
items.description: The Generic Hotel takes inspiration from The Standard over at 8300 Sunset Blvd in West Hollywood.

items.title: Pegasus Concierge
items.description: This hotel is modeled after the actual Sunset Tower Hotel you can visit at 8358 Sunset Blvd in Los Angeles.

items.title: GoPostal Building
items.description: Smash up the cars parked here and your stock price will go up.

items.title: Skate Park 1
items.description: There's a huge halfpipe here with a couple of ramps if you want to catch some serious air.

items.title: Property: The Hen House
items.description: Any character can buy this for $80,000 and it brings in $920 every week. You'll get calls asking you to deal with attackers, chase down stolen cash, or fix random business issues.

items.title: Property: Sonar Collections Dock
items.description: This one costs $250,000 and any character can grab it. Take the sub and collect 30 pieces of nuclear waste floating around underwater across San Andreas, earning $23,000 per piece. You only need 11 pieces to break even, but collecting all 30 gets you $440,000 in profit.

items.title: Property: Hookies
items.description: Franklin or Michael can pick this up for $600,000 and it pays $4,700 weekly. You'll get calls to fight off attacks or track down thieves who hit the place.

items.title: Property: McKenzie Field Hangar
items.description: Trevor can buy this for $150,000 and run drug trafficking missions by either driving or flying shipments. Ground runs pay $5,000 while air drops pay $7,000, though flying those shipments can get sketchy.

items.title: Property: Los Santos Customs
items.description: Franklin pays $349,000 for this garage and pulls in $1,600 weekly, which sounds weak until you realize every single car upgrade becomes completely free once he owns it.

items.title: Property: Downtown Cab Co.
items.description: Franklin can buy this for $200,000 and make $2,000 per week, plus he can run cab fares for extra money. Private fare requests pop up sometimes and those can get pretty strange. Also Franklin rides all cabs free after purchasing this.

items.title: Property: Doppler Cinema
items.description: Michael drops $10,000,000 on this cinema and pulls in $132,200 every week showing films across Los Santos. He might need to handle gang attacks, deal with protestors, do promo flyovers, or recover stolen cash. The upfront cost is brutal but it pays itself back fast.

items.title: Property: Pitchers
items.description: Any character can buy Pitchers, the famous Vinewood bar, for $750,000 and earn $7,100 weekly. Sometimes you'll need to fight off trouble or chase down cash after someone robs the place.

items.title: Property: Vinewood Garage
items.description: Michael pays $30,000 for this garage and gets 4-car storage with no weekly income. Drive up to the big door and hit right on the D-pad to store a car, or walk up and press right to go inside and pick a vehicle. Collector's Edition cars like the Hotknife and Carbon RS plus the Social Club Elegy RH8 can be claimed inside by pressing right on the D-pad.

items.title: Property: Tequi-La-La
items.description: This bar pulls double duty as a concert venue and costs two million dollars with any character able to buy it. You'll pull in sixteen thousand five hundred per week, and honestly it pays for itself way faster than most properties in the game so it's a solid pick for making your money back quickly.

items.title: Property: Los Santos Golf Club
items.description: Any character can drop a hundred and fifty million on this place which brings in two hundred sixty-four thousand five hundred weekly, and buying it makes golf free forever while letting you wear whatever outfit you want on the course. That said this is hands down the worst investment you can make since it takes an eternity to break even on your money.

items.title: Property: Tivoli Cinema
items.description: Michael can grab this classic cinema for thirty million and it earns one hundred forty-two thousand three hundred each week showing movies to Los Santos residents. He'll get phone calls sometimes asking him to handle gang trouble at the theater, air-drop promotional flyers around town, or chase down someone who stole cash from the place.

items.title: Property: Los Santos International Hangar
items.description: Franklin and Michael can both buy this for just over one point three million and each character gets one huge hangar to store any aircraft they purchase or steal. Stand at the entrance and press right on the D-pad to choose which plane or helicopter you want to take out, and if you buy a Rhino tank online it shows up stored here too.

items.title: Property: Ten Cent Theater
items.description: Michael can pick up this theater for twenty million which plays movies and hosts live shows while earning two hundred sixty-four thousand weekly. Expect phone calls where Michael has to deal with gang attacks on the venue, air-drop marketing flyers for promotions, or recover money that got stolen from the business.

items.title: Property: Pillbox Hill Garage
items.description: Trevor can buy this spot for thirty thousand and gets a four-car garage out of the deal. Pull up to the big door in a vehicle and press right on the D-pad to park inside, or walk up on foot and press right to enter and swap between your stored cars. The special rides like the Collector's Edition Hotknife and Carbon RS plus the Social Club Elegy RH8 can all be grabbed by pressing right once you're standing inside the garage.

items.title: Property: Car Scrapyard
items.description: Any character can grab this salvage yard for two hundred seventy-five thousand and your weekly take depends entirely on how many vehicles get destroyed while you play, earning you one hundred fifty bucks per wrecked car. You'll sometimes get a call telling you to defend the yard from people trying to attack it.

items.title: Property: Towing Impound
items.description: Franklin can buy this tow operation for one hundred fifty thousand and a Tow Truck spawns here that he can use to haul cars around for five hundred dollars per towed vehicle.

items.title: Property: Grove Street Garage
items.description: Franklin can pick up his own four-car garage for thirty thousand dollars. Drive up to the door and hit right on the D-pad to store whatever you're driving, or walk up and press right to go inside and pick a different car to take out. The Collector's Edition Hotknife and Carbon RS along with the Social Club Elegy RH8 are all available by pressing right when you're standing in the garage.

items.title: Property: Puerto del Sol Marina Slip
items.description: Any character can buy this marina slip for seventy-five thousand and each one gets their own spot to park boats. It works just like the hangars or helipads where you can store multiple boats and press right on the D-pad when you're nearby to choose which one you want to take out on the water.

items.title: Property: Vespucci Helipad
items.description: Franklin and Michael can both purchase their own helipad for four hundred nineteen thousand eight hundred fifty and each character gets a spot to store helicopters. Stand close to the helipad and press right on the D-pad to pick which chopper you want to fly.

items.title: Property: Smoke on the Water
items.description: Franklin can buy this legal medical cannabis dispensary for two hundred four thousand and it brings in nine thousand three hundred each week. He'll get calls now and then asking him to retrieve shipments that went missing, track down stolen product from the store, or handle situations where he needs to dodge the cops.
